CustomField.formula:
IF( AND( LicenseType__r.DurationofLicenseInMonths__c = 36, ISPICKVAL(LicensePeriod__c, 'Next License Period')), "Triennial 1st Year",
IF( AND( LicenseType__r.DurationofLicenseInMonths__c = 24, ISPICKVAL(LicensePeriod__c, 'Next License Period')), "Biennial 1st Year",
IF( AND( LicenseType__r.DurationofLicenseInMonths__c = 12, ISPICKVAL(LicensePeriod__c, 'Next License Period')), "Annual 1st Year",
LicenseType__r.CurrentLicenseYear__c)))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indicates the current license year we are in, if this Application is Approved today.
CustomField.label: Current License Year
